instructions.quote: institutions shall disclose information on their exposures towards non-financial corporates operating in carbon-related sectors, and on the quality of those exposures, including non-performing status, stage 2 classification, and related provisions as well as maturity buckets;

Institutions shall include in the rows of the template the breakdown of the gross carrying amount of loans and advances, debt securities and equity instruments to non-financial corporations, other than those held for trading, by sector of economic activities using the Nomenclature of Economic Activities (NACE) codes, laid down in Regulation (EC) No 1893/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council, based on the principal activity of the counterparty.

In particular, reference is made to the sectors listed in Sections A to H and Section L of Annex I to Regulation (EC) No 1893/2006, which include the oil, gas, mining and transportation sectors, as sectors that highly contribute to climate change, as specified in Recital 6 of Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2020/1818; and a subtotal of exposures towards “other sectors” not mentioned in that Recital.
The counterparty NACE sector allocation shall be based on the nature of the direct counterparty.

Institutions shall disclose the gross carrying amount, referred to in Part 1 of Annex V to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/451, of those exposures towards non-financial corporates, including loans and advances, debt securities and equity instruments, classified in the accounting portfolios in the banking book in accordance with that Implementing Regulation, excluding financial assets held for trading or held for sale assets.

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 1, columns l - p, point (b)
instructions.quote: where an exposure has no stated maturity for reasons other than the counterparty having the choice of the repayment date, or in the case of equity holdings, the amount of this exposure shall be disclosed in the largest maturity bucket ‘> 20 years’;

instructions.quote: Institutions shall include in this template information on exposures in the banking book, including loans and advances, debt securities and equity instruments not held-for-trading and not held-for-sale, towards non-financial corporates, on loans collateralized with immovable property and on repossessed real estate collaterals, exposed to chronic and acute climate-related hazards, with a breakdown by sector of economic activity (NACE classification) and by geography of location of the activity of the counterparty or of the collateral, for those sectors and geographical areas subject to climate change acute and chronic events.
The classification of the joint exposures towards more than one obligor shall be based on the characteristics of the obligor that was the most relevant for the institution to grant the exposure.

Institutions shall disclose the information in this template on a best effort basis and explain in the narrative accompanying the template the sources of information and methods that they have used to identify exposures subject to climate-change physical risk.

Institutions shall disclose the gross carrying amount as defined in Part 1 of Annex V to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/451 of those exposures towards non-financial corporates (including loans and advances, debt securities and equity instruments), classified under the accounting portfolios in the banking book in accordance with that Implementing Regulation, excluding financial assets held for trading and held for sale assets.

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 5, columns c - o
instructions.quote: The gross carrying amount of exposures prone to impact from climate change physical events may be equal to the full exposure amount disclosed in column (b) of this template or may be a part of that exposure amount.

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 5, columns c - g, point (b)
instructions.quote: where an exposure has no stated maturity for reasons other than the counterparty having the choice of the repayment date, the amount of this exposure shall be disclosed in column ‘> 20 years’;

Institutions shall disclose the gross carrying amount of exposures sensitive to impact from chronic climate-change events only, including hazards relating to gradual changes in weather and climate and having a possible impact on economic output and productivity.

Institutions shall disclose the gross carrying amount of exposures sensitive to impact from acute climate change events only, including hazards that may cause sudden damage to properties, disruption of supply chains, and depreciation of assets.
Institutions shall disclose the gross carrying amount subject to impact from both chronic and acute climate change events, referred to in columns (h) and (i).

interpretations.subject: T5 rows
interpretations.reading: Rows 1-9 and 13 hold exposures towards non-financial corporations by the counterparty's NACE section (13 = sections other than A-H and L). Rows 10-12 hold loans collateralised by residential / commercial immovable property and repossessed collateral, whatever the counterparty. They are separate populations, not 'of which' rows: an exposure to a non-financial corporation collateralised by immovable property appears in its sector row and in row 10 or 11. The template has no total row.
interpretations.basis: Annex XL, Template 5, point 2 names three populations: exposures 'towards non-financial corporates', 'loans collateralized with immovable property' and 'repossessed real estate collaterals'; column b limits the gross carrying amount to exposures towards non-financial corporates. EBA/ITS/2026/02 (EU CRFR2, Part 1 para 25 b-c) states the same split explicitly for the successor template.

interpretations.subject: T1 rows 1 and 53
interpretations.reading: Row 1 is the subtotal of the section rows printed under it (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, L); row 53 is the subtotal of rows 54 (K) and 55 (J, M–U); row 56 (TOTAL) is rows 1 + 53. Division, group and class rows (e.g. B.05, D35.11) are 'of which' rows of their section and are not added again.
interpretations.basis: The printed template places 'I - Accommodation and food service activities' between H and L inside the row-1 group, while Annex XL, Template 1, point 3 names Sections A to H and L as the sectors that highly contribute to climate change. The template's own layout is followed so that its rows add up; the difference is Section I only.
